    box=(72.,80.,528.,700.)
    rows=[Row('intro','備註三十一：丙方的设备交付及服务义务：',block=0,box=box)]
    rows.extend(Row(f'b{i}',f'“{i+1}、公司已交付检测设备，丙方应保留原始验收记录。”',block=0,box=box) for i in range(27))
    rows.extend([Row('healthy','一、另一项业务进展',block=1,box=(72.,710.,528.,730.)),
                 Row('healthy_body','公司已交付独立的新设备。',block=2,box=(72.,740.,528.,760.))])
    parsed,owned=source(tuple(rows))
    result,contexts=run_pipeline(parsed)
    packages,_facts,continuity,blocked=prepare_native_materials(parsed,result,
        work_budget=WorkBudget(16_000_000),_native_contexts=contexts)
    evidence={'diagnostics':result['structure']['diagnostics'],
      'semantic_units':result['structure']['semantic_units'],
      'blocked':sorted(blocked),'anchors':[p['anchor_unit_ids'] for p in packages],
      'names':{key:unit.unit_id for key,unit in owned.items()},'continuity_complete':continuity['complete']}
    (Path(__file__).parent/'limit-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    # The first over-limit target and following members are still within the
    # same explicit note; a budget boundary is not a new source introduction.
    assert {owned[f'b{i}'].unit_id for i in (23,24,25,26)} <= set(blocked)
    assert all(not {owned[f'b{i}'].unit_id for i in (23,24,25,26)} & set(p['anchor_unit_ids']) for p in packages)
    assert owned['healthy_body'].unit_id not in blocked
    assert any(owned['healthy_body'].unit_id in p['anchor_unit_ids'] for p in packages)
